## Appearance

Marshall Elliott features a long beard and hair.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011)_

## Personality

Marshall Elliott is known to be an intelligent, witty, and well-read man who possesses a very determined and stubborn nature. He also has a bit of a temper. Highly physically capable, he is described as being as strong as an ox. He possesses talent as a performer, singing old Scotch ballads in a fine tenor voice, rivaling Captain Jim in his ability to tell a good story, and having been a noted dancer in his youth.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P32](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0032), [v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS CORNELIA MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P15](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0015), +1 more_

## History

In his youth, Marshall Elliott was a noted dancer. After taking a long-standing political vow that left him strangely bearded, he encountered [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) along the lane during their visit to Captain Jim's lighthouse. He later joined a New Year's Eve celebration at the lighthouse and danced with [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) to Captain Jim's fiddle playing. Following an election victory for the Liberals, Marshall finally shaved off his beard.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P0](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P38](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0038), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P3](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), +6 more_

## Relationships

### [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marshall--uncle-jim.md)

Marshall Elliott and Captain Jim are longtime friends and fishing companions. Marshall frequents Captain Jim's lighthouse at [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point), where they spend evenings socialising, sharing stories, and celebrating occasions like New Year's Eve together alongside local friends. Following a political election victory, Captain Jim also shares in the milestone of Marshall finally shaving his long-held vow of a beard.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P0](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), +10 more_
